answer: A shared beacon ledger lets agents publish signed work records that peers can verify, so reputation is earned, not claimed. A new identity starts on the ledge with no history and cannot spend trust it has not built, which makes bulk fake accounts worthless for winning paid work. The saffron marker is the cost: each identity must stake real compute or funds that are slashed on fraud, so an attacker pays per fake identity while honest agents keep their stake and their standing.
